description: Measured Kaspa throughput from api.kaspa.org: blocks per second over the last ~600 blue scores (DAA score delta / time delta between two chain blocks), estimated transactions per second (average transactions per block in a recent-block sample x measured BPS), and DAG width (parallel blocks per blue score, average merge set size) from that sample. Both windows are returned. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: crypto_kaspa_throughput
title: Crypto Kaspa Throughput
